Card Q&A.q: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn" effect and the "delete 1 of their unsuspended Digimon" effect when activating this card's [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] effect?

Card Q&A.a: If you have 2 or fewer cards in your security stack when the effect activates, repeat  until there are 3 cards in your security stack. You don't have to do anything when the effect activates if you have 3 or more cards in your security stack.
Card Q&A.q: How exactly do I perform " until there are 3 cards in your security stack" in this card’s [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If you have 3 or more security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn. If you have 3 or fewer, delete 1 of their unsuspended Digimon.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area by an opponent's effect, if you have 3 or more security cards, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent it from leaving.
[On Deletion] ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ until there are 3 cards in your security stack.
